invariants.name: no literal border widths
invariants.diagnosis: A hairline is the signature weight of this UI, and an inlined [0.5px] opts that edge out of the token layer: it can then only be changed by find-and-replace, and it diverges from Kommands, which reads the same upstream scale. Utilities exist for both weights and all four sides (border-hairline, border-thick, border-{t,r,b,l}-{hairline,thick}), generated into frontend/src/styles/tokens.css from tokens.source.json. A genuinely new weight is a value to add to kollektiv/design/tokens.json, never a literal to inline here. Scoped to borders on purpose: text-[Npx] has its own invariant below with its own exclusions, and rounded-[Npx] and the arbitrary sizing literals are separate sweeps still open in the checklist, so a broader pattern would be red on arrival.

invariants.name: no discarded errors
invariants.diagnosis: An error in the second return position is not `_ = `, so the checklist's `_ = ` grep verified 'no blank error-ignores' for two months while forty `x, _ := f()` sites sat in the tree (HEALTH_LOG, 2026-09-08). Seven of them dereferenced a nil FileInfo when a file vanished mid-listing, one fired a malformed time-of-day trigger at midnight, and two reported a body cut off mid-transfer as the body. Handle the error where it happens, or say why the discard is right in a trailing `//nolint:errcheck // reason` on the same line, the way `players.go`'s degrade-to-empty does. The lookahead leaves out what is not an error: the comma-ok form of a type assertion (`v, _ := x.(T)`) is idiomatic and a discarded `ok` there is a deliberate zero value, and `resolveTarget`'s second value is the loader name. A map lookup's comma-ok with the `ok` discarded is neither and is written without it. Tests are excluded because `_ =` in a test is the test choosing what to assert.

invariants.name: text uses the type scale
invariants.diagnosis: The type scale names three steps below Tailwind's smallest (text-3xs 9px, text-2xs 10px, text-1xs 11px, text-xs 12px), generated into frontend/src/styles/tokens.css from tokens.source.json. An inlined text-[10px] is the same value with no single place to change it and no way for a token sync to reach it: tokens.source.json is vendored from kollektiv/design/tokens.json and shared with Kommands, so when the scale moves upstream the literal keeps its old value and the tree ends up with two scales a pixel apart, and nothing fails (#368). A size the scale does not name is a value to add to kollektiv/design/tokens.json, not a literal to inline; 8px sat below the floor and was rounded to text-3xs rather than earning a token of its own (#163), and the one 13px went to text-sm. The scheduler editor was swept first under #163 and the rest of frontend/src under #368, which is when this widened from tiles/scheduler to the whole tree. One exclusion by name: worlds/scene/Planet.tsx's 7px label is scaled by camera distance through drei's Html distanceFactor, so the literal is an input to a transform rather than a screen size, and the file says so where it sits. The assets directory is excluded only because its fonts and logo are binary and the runner would otherwise report them as unreadable.

invariants.name: scheduler colours live in blockMeta
invariants.diagnosis: The graph's palette is deliberately literal rather than tokenised, because the token layer does not name a category or port-type hue and giving it one is a suite-wide change; blockMeta.ts says so at length. That reasoning only holds while the palette lives in one file, and it did not: the same fallback grey sat at twelve call sites, the data edge's stroke was the string port's colour copy-pasted into two files, and the custom-attribute badge was the trigger hue with nothing to do with triggers, so retuning one would have moved the other (#163). Read a colour through blockMeta's accessors instead. Where a semantic token already exists, use it: danger, success and warning are why this grep finds nothing left to tokenise. The pattern matches exactly six hex digits, so the eight-digit hex-plus-alpha inside an arbitrary box-shadow is left alone; those cannot take a themed colour without color-mix and are documented where they sit.

generated.diagnosis: A non-empty diff means one of the three generated token files was hand-edited, or tokens.source.json was refreshed without regenerating. Both are bugs: the next run reverts the edit, and the underlying value never reaches Kommands. website/tokens.css is the marketing site's copy, the same values as plain :root custom properties because that site has no Tailwind and no build step. It exists because website/styles.css used to hand-mirror the app's dark theme and had already drifted: its --font-mono was missing Liberation Mono.
